description: default permissions + set-fullscreen (video player) and opener (external links, V40: the command alone is not enough — without a URL scope open_url refuses every link, so http/https/mailto are allowed, like ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS in open-external.ts); http scope: any https host + local IPFS gateway (V27) — mini-app URLs are filtered client-side (safe-external-url, V25). Global shortcuts are registered from Rust, so the webview does not need them (N30). app-commands: the app's own commands (AppManifest in build.rs) — for this window only, IPFS viewer windows show foreign sites and get nothing; updater + process:allow-restart — in-app update: download the signed release build, install it and restart (use-app-update); process:allow-exit — Ctrl+Q on Windows and Linux, where the window close button only hides the window to the tray (helpers/desktop/quit-shortcut)
